mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.elder_id, e.elder_name, r.record_date, r.record_time, r.blood_pressure_high, r.blood_pressure_low, r.heart_rate, r.body_temp, r.blood_sugar, r.blood_oxygen, r.weight, r.steps, r.sleep_hours, r.is_abnormal, r.abnormal_items, r.remark, r.tenant_id, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from biz_health_record r left join biz_elder e on r.elder_id = e.elder_id and e.del_flag = '0'

case when #{bloodPressureHigh} is not null and (#{bloodPressureHigh} < 90 or #{bloodPressureHigh} > 140) or #{bloodPressureLow} is not null and (#{bloodPressureLow} < 60 or #{bloodPressureLow} > 90) or #{heartRate} is not null and (#{heartRate} < 60 or #{heartRate} > 100) or #{bodyTemp} is not null and (#{bodyTemp} < 36.0 or #{bodyTemp} > 37.3) or #{bloodSugar} is not null and #{bloodSugar} > 7.0 or #{bloodOxygen} is not null and #{bloodOxygen} < 95.0 then '1' else '0' end

concat_ws(',', case when #{bloodPressureHigh} is not null and #{bloodPressureHigh} > 140 then '收缩压偏高' end, case when #{bloodPressureHigh} is not null and #{bloodPressureHigh} < 90 then '收缩压偏低' end, case when #{bloodPressureLow} is not null and #{bloodPressureLow} > 90 then '舒张压偏高' end, case when #{bloodPressureLow} is not null and #{bloodPressureLow} < 60 then '舒张压偏低' end, case when #{heartRate} is not null and #{heartRate} < 60 then '心率偏低' end, case when #{heartRate} is not null and #{heartRate} > 100 then '心率偏高' end, case when #{bodyTemp} is not null and #{bodyTemp} < 36.0 then '体温偏低' end, case when #{bodyTemp} is not null and #{bodyTemp} > 37.3 then '体温偏高' end, case when #{bloodSugar} is not null and #{bloodSugar} > 7.0 then '血糖偏高' end, case when #{bloodOxygen} is not null and #{bloodOxygen} < 95.0 then '血氧偏低' end )
mapper.insert: insert into biz_health_record (elder_id, record_date, record_time, blood_pressure_high, blood_pressure_low, heart_rate, body_temp, blood_sugar, blood_oxygen, weight, steps, sleep_hours, is_abnormal, abnormal_items, remark, tenant_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{elderId}, #{recordDate}, #{recordTime}, #{bloodPressureHigh}, #{bloodPressureLow}, #{heartRate}, #{bodyTemp}, #{bloodSugar}, #{bloodOxygen}, #{weight}, #{steps}, #{sleepHours}, , , #{remark}, #{tenantId}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update biz_health_record set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select: select count(distinct elder_id) from biz_health_record where del_flag = '0' and is_abnormal = '1' and record_date = curdate()
